settings.title: Refund Policy & 30-Day Guarantee
settings.content:
At SafePet, we stand behind our products. We want you and your furry companion to feel 100% safe and confident during every drive. That is why we offer a 30-Day Money-Back Guarantee on all our active pet safety gear.

How it works:

  • 30-Day Testing Period: You have 30 days from the date of delivery to test our products in your car with your dog.
  • Promotional FREE Items: For promotional FREE items (where customers only cover shipping & handling), please note that the $9.95 shipping and handling fee is non-refundable as it goes directly toward warehouse fulfillment, packaging, and carrier fees. However, we will gladly replace any damaged, incorrect, or defective items free of charge.
  • Standard Items: If you purchased a standard priced item and want a refund, we will refund the full purchase price of the product.

How to initiate a return:

  1. Email us at support@safepetstrap.com with your order number and the reason for your return.
  2. Our customer care team will respond within 24 hours with a return authorization number and return instructions.
  3. Do not send packages back to our warehouse address without prior authorization, as they will not be processed.
